Container.Name: nuvira-server-pro
Container.Overview: NuviraHub Pro server, for teams that support many computers with NuviraHub, the self-hosted remote desktop and remote support app for Windows and Linux.[br][br] Everything in the open source server (signalling, relay, signed app updates, end-to-end encrypted sessions) plus: server address books shared by the team, accounts and roles, central rules for the devices, web console, two-factor authentication, single sign-on (OpenID Connect), session log and custom installers.[br][br] Needs a NuviraHub Pro licence key (see nuvirahub.dev; free for members of the Founders Program). Without a key it works like the open source server. The app is the same for both servers.
Container.Requires: A NuviraHub Pro licence key; the server checks it online at start-up and once a day (7 days of grace without Internet). Forward port 21116 UDP (and TCP for the WebSocket fallback) from the router to Unraid. To sign in to the web console from the Internet, put it behind an HTTPS reverse proxy: plain-HTTP logins are accepted only from the local network. Back up the Data folder: it holds the server's identity, which the apps pin, and the key of the address books.
Container.Changes: ### 0.14.0 (2026-10-31) - Current release of the Pro server, for the apps up to 0.15.0 (Windows and Linux): https://nuvirahub.dev

Config.Name: Port (UDP)
Config.Description: Signalling and relay (QUIC). Forward it on the router.

Config.Name: Port (TCP)
Config.Description: WebSocket fallback for networks that block UDP, app updates and the web console. Forward it on the router.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, server certificate, address book key, and the app updates you publish to your devices (updates folder). Back up the whole folder.

Config.Name: Licence key
Config.Description: NuviraHub Pro licence key. Without it the Pro modules stay off (signalling and relay keep working).

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: First administrator, created only if no account exists yet.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: At least 8 characters. Empty: a random password is written once to the log. Used only at the first start; lost password: docker exec nuvira-server-pro /nuvira-server reset-password.

Config.Name: Session log days
Config.Description: Days the session log is kept.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: https:// address of the console from the browser (reverse proxy), e.g. https://console.example.com. Needed by single sign-on.

Config.Name: SSO provider
Config.Description: OpenID Connect issuer, e.g. https://login.microsoftonline.com/TENANT-ID/v2.0 or https://accounts.google.com. Empty: no single sign-on.

Config.Name: SSO client ID
Config.Description: Application (client) ID registered at the provider.

Config.Name: SSO button name
Config.Description: Shown as Sign in with NAME, e.g. Microsoft or Google.

Config.Name: SSO username claim
Config.Description: Claim used as the NuviraHub username; empty: preferred_username, then email.

Config.Name: SSO administrators group
Config.Description: Value of the groups claim that makes an account administrator (Entra ID: object ID of the group).

Config.Name: WebSocket listen
Config.Description: TCP address of the WebSocket fallback, the app updates and the console; off to disable it.

Config.Name: Limits per address
Config.Description: Limits on registrations and connection requests per address (local addresses are always exempt); off to disable them.
